project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Project identity that also prefixes meter identifiers and names the readings table; renaming requires data migration.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; Noise runtime behavior does not read it.

enabled.label: Project enabled
enabled.help: Master notification gate; the reserved TEST row is still excluded from automatic scraping (INV-NOISE-11).

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: Listener endpoint; a project without it creates no scrape demand and cannot deliver messages (INV-NOISE-13).

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Listener instance passed independently for every project delivery.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Sending-account identifier required for client delivery.

whatsapp_group_id.label: WhatsApp groups
whatsapp_group_id.help: Comma-separated destinations; each is attempted independently.

enable_5min.label: 5-minute alerts
enable_5min.help: Enables the five-minute assessment family and contributes scrape demand.

enable_half_hourly.label: In-hour assessments
enable_half_hourly.help: Enables assessment-minute messages and contributes scrape demand.

enable_hourly.label: Hourly reports
enable_hourly.help: Enables completed-hour messages and contributes scrape demand.

enable_three_hour_summary.label: Three-hour summary
enable_three_hour_summary.help: Explicit opt-in for the three-hour rollup.

enable_morning_summary.label: Morning summary
enable_morning_summary.help: Explicit opt-in for the overnight rollup.

enable_evening_summary.label: Evening summary
enable_evening_summary.help: Explicit opt-in for the fixed 07:00–19:00 daytime closeout.

enable_15min_average_exceedance.label: 15-minute average exceedance
enable_15min_average_exceedance.help: Opt-in exact-slot alert at SGT :17, :32, and :47; it averages the preceding three Leq5min readings and sends only limit exceedances (INV-NOISE-17).

fifteen_min_average_start_hhmm.label: 15-minute average start
fifteen_min_average_start_hhmm.help: Optional inclusive SGT start for the 15-minute average cadence; blank leaves it unrestricted (INV-NOISE-05).

fifteen_min_average_end_hhmm.label: 15-minute average end
fifteen_min_average_end_hhmm.help: Optional exclusive SGT end for the 15-minute average cadence; end at or before start wraps overnight (INV-NOISE-05).

enable_sunday_leq12h_hourly.label: Sunday Leq12hr hourly
enable_sunday_leq12h_hourly.help: Explicit opt-in for Sunday daytime assessment; deliberately bypasses Sunday notification suppression.

enable_7am_7pm_leq12hr_table.label: 07:00–19:00 Leq12hr table
enable_7am_7pm_leq12hr_table.help: Explicit opt-in for the 07:00–18:00 hourly table.

allow_expiry_alert.label: Subscription expiry alerts
allow_expiry_alert.help: Allows the limits refresh to warn before a NoiseLynx subscription expires.

days_left_before_alerting.label: Expiry warning days
days_left_before_alerting.help: Advance warning window constrained to 1–365 days.

alert_whatsapp_gid.label: Expiry alert group
alert_whatsapp_gid.help: Destination for subscription warnings, often an internal rather than client group.

noise_meters_included.label: Included meters
noise_meters_included.help: Optional RecID allowlist applied only to client message rows; storage, assessment, sheets, and failsafes retain every meter (INV-NOISE-07).

remove_sunday_notifications.label: Mute Sundays
remove_sunday_notifications.help: Suppresses delivery from Sunday 07:00 through Monday 06:59, not calendar Sunday (INV-NOISE-04).

remove_ph_notifications.label: Mute public holidays
remove_ph_notifications.help: Suppresses delivery only; public-holiday assessments still select Sun/PH limits (INV-NOISE-03).

hourly_exceedance_only.label: Hourly exceedance only
hourly_exceedance_only.help: Suppresses all-clear client hourly messages without suppressing independent ops failsafes (INV-NOISE-09).

hourly_exceeded_meters_only.label: Only exceeded meters
hourly_exceeded_meters_only.help: Filters hourly message rows to meters with a five-minute, Leq1hr, or Leq12hr exceedance; storage and calculations are unchanged.

half_hourly_send_if_exceed.label: Relay in-hour exceedances
half_hourly_send_if_exceed.help: Also sends an existing half-hourly exceedance message to alternate groups; it creates no extra assessment.

exceedance_half_hourly_wa_groups.label: In-hour exceedance groups
exceedance_half_hourly_wa_groups.help: Additional half-hourly exceedance destinations, de-duplicated against ordinary groups.

five_min_start_hhmm.label: 5-minute window start
five_min_start_hhmm.help: Optional HHMM start; a one-sided or overnight window is valid (INV-NOISE-05).

five_min_end_hhmm.label: 5-minute window end
five_min_end_hhmm.help: Exclusive HHMM end; end at or before start wraps overnight (INV-NOISE-05).

half_hourly_start_hhmm.label: In-hour window start
half_hourly_start_hhmm.help: Optional HHMM start; a one-sided or overnight window is valid (INV-NOISE-05).

half_hourly_end_hhmm.label: In-hour window end
half_hourly_end_hhmm.help: Exclusive HHMM end; end at or before start wraps overnight (INV-NOISE-05).

hourly_start_hhmm.label: Hourly window start
hourly_start_hhmm.help: Optional HHMM start; a one-sided or overnight window is valid (INV-NOISE-05).

hourly_end_hhmm.label: Hourly window end
hourly_end_hhmm.help: Exclusive HHMM end; end at or before start wraps overnight (INV-NOISE-05).

five_min_formatter.label: 5-minute format
five_min_formatter.help: Selects the documented five-minute message strategy.

half_hourly_formatter.label: In-hour format
half_hourly_formatter.help: Selects the documented in-hour message strategy.

hourly_formatter.label: Hourly format
hourly_formatter.help: Selects the documented completed-hour message strategy.

evening_formatter.label: Evening format
evening_formatter.help: Selects the fixed daytime closeout renderer.

morning_summary_start_hhmm.label: Morning summary time
morning_summary_start_hhmm.help: HHMM at which the overnight summary becomes eligible.

assessment_readings_mm_array(\"35,45,55\.label: Assessment minutes
assessment_readings_mm_array(\"35,45,55\.help: Literal quoted column containing comma-separated minute marks; invalid values are dropped and an empty result falls back to 30 (INV-NOISE-12).

debug_google_sheet_id.label: Debug workbook
debug_google_sheet_id.help: Optional diagnostic sheet sink; it is not the operational message log.

google_sheet_id.label: Noise analysis workbook
google_sheet_id.help: Persistent workbook used by Noise sheet jobs.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone used for windows and timestamps; production behavior assumes Asia/Singapore.

source_type.label: Upstream source
source_type.help: Selects the upstream adapter and its isolated credential/browser context; legacy noiselynx normalizes to default. The database accepts future text values, but an unsupported value is isolated to this project as failed_config_validation until its adapter is deployed.

updated_at.label: Updated at
updated_at.help: Bookkeeping timestamp not maintained automatically by a trigger.

constraints.name: days_left_before_alerting_check
constraints.help: Expiry warning days must be between 1 and 365.
